native.method: decoded-frame inspection plus passthrough RGB scan of every decoded frame at 320x180, panel band x 90-230 y 4-55
native.note: Host panel is the measurement. icacls success is not EVERYONE-M. Restore after the hold is not onset.

finshield.method: panel crop 1120,20,1600,700 scaled to 80x35 plus full-frame minus taskbar
finshield.note: Panel stayed LIMITED. icacls exit 5, Access denied, and packaged TEMP text are not the desktop measurement.
